current.text: He tore his patellar tendon and is out now. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.
A return in March is the likely timeline. A return before March would be a surprise.
He was playing well before the injury and ranked 105th after last season's trade deadline.
He is not draftable this season.
Golden State is reportedly treating this season as a gap year and may rest veterans to protect its lottery odds. That makes a big role after a late return less certain.

durable.text: He has had knee issues since college.

note: Do not spend on him in our auction. Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 261, ESPN rank 345), and a torn patellar tendon with a likely March return leaves almost no regular season before our playoffs in weeks 19 to 21. Watch his return timeline on waivers in late February. Even then, his 2025-26 line (2.5 3PM, few rebounds and assists) offers little, and he would be coming back on a team that may be playing for lottery odds.
